answer_1.quote: LLMs can be prompted in natural language to jointly score and comment on a given essay... feedback comment generation ... we examine LLMs' ability to generate multi-dimensional analytic writing assessments, including scores and feedback comments.
datasets: L2 English graduate-level literature review corpus
answer_1.outputs: scores on 9 criteria and essay-level feedback comments

answer_2.quote: We use QWK and AAR1 and three widely adopted machine translation metrics, i.e., BLEU, ROUGE-L, and BERTScore, to evaluate the reliability of the generated scores and comments between contrastive condition pairs.

answer_3.quote: ProEval utilizes LLMs to extract problems... and to characterize their specificity and potential helpfulness. We also prompted o1-mini to directly assess the specificity and helpfulness of a feedback comment.
models: GPT-4 (for Problem Extraction, Classification, and Relevance Check)
methods: LLM-as-judge scoring of specificity and helpfulness

answer_4.quote: Most essays in the corpus were assessed by three or two independent human experts... 31 students evaluated the quality of human assessments on a 4-point Likert scale... manual annotation by two annotators was performed to validate ProEval.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators rated assessments on usefulness (Likert scale) and performed detailed annotation of extracted problems, evaluating relevance, specificity, and helpfulness.
